item.title: Fix window.py so unittest passes for all inputs
item.brief:
In this repository, `python3 -m unittest` fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes, without changing the tests, and make sure the function is correct for every input, not just the tested ones. Commit your fix.

Inspect the implementation and existing tests, infer the intended window semantics, and implement a principled fix that covers edge cases for the full input domain. Do not modify tests. Run `python3 -m unittest` and any focused checks needed to establish correctness. Commit the fix on the assigned branch. This repository ships locally; do not push.

Run an independent reviewer against that same committed HEAD and return the required review record with the reviewer's exact agent id. Do not rely on an earlier review.
